detail.title: Investigating Theoretical Landscapes in Consciousness Science
detail.summary: Continuing the project on scientific theories of consciousness by initiating a specific literature search to contrast Integrated Information Theory (IIT) and Global Neuronal Workspace Theory (GNWT). These frameworks represent distinct paradigms in current neuroscientific attempts to define the physical correlates of consciousness.

children.title: Integrated Information Theory vs Global Neuronal Workspace Theory comparative review

detail.reason: Directly addresses the project question by seeking comparative literature that articulates the distinct empirical predictions and foundational disagreements between these two major theories.
